findings.summary: The Fish completion script breaks because format_completion now emits three lines per item (type, value, help), but Fish splits output into one list element per line, so the loop misparses items, `test` errors on missing indices, and no completions are produced.
A help string that is literally `_` is indistinguishable from the 'no help' sentinel and is silently dropped (same problem in the zsh format).
Escaping a newline as the two characters `\n` shows a literal `\n` in Fish's completion description; replacing newlines with a space would display better.
The `:issue:` changelog entry has no `:pr:` reference (cosmetic).
